concepts.title: Session
concepts.description: An owned snapshot of Agent configuration and ongoing work across Turns.

concepts.title: Turn
concepts.description: One period of agent work with its own saved Items and terminal outcome.

concepts.title: Private Run
concepts.description: An internal harness launch and fenced worker generation. Several public Turns can share it.

concepts.title: Schedule
concepts.description: An application integration that reserves occurrences and submits canonical Session input.

concepts.title: What survives a worker
concepts.description: Saved resource content, Items and Artifacts live in encrypted storage; S3 Files optionally preserves native workspace state.

concepts.title: Capability envelope
concepts.description: Resolved tools and independent enforcing layers constrain the autonomous agent.

externals.title: Caller
externals.description: An authenticated SDK caller or verified provider event.

externals.title: Result destination
externals.description: The trusted provider destination for saved terminal Turn output.

externals.title: Model provider
externals.description: The model service configured by the deployment operator.

externals.title: Connected service
externals.description: A service reached through a declared, authorized tool or provider adapter.
